scope.object: Prompt instructions and selected demonstrations around fixed language models.

scope.retention: Selected compiled prompts are retained for held-out puzzle evaluation, cross-model transfer, and short game rollouts.
scope.weights: Target weights remain frozen; no policy weight training.
scope.limit: Specialized APO/Harness evaluation, not evidence that all models improve or puzzle gains transfer to stronger chess play.

limits: Public Lichess pretraining exposure cannot be excluded. Rating and length are descriptive and correlated, not independent difficulty factors or model playing Elo.
Optimizer comparisons use recommended defaults rather than equalized total compute. Minimal common prompt is not the strongest model-specific manual baseline.
Three-run puzzle results use unadjusted one-sided Welch tests. Cross-model source prompts are selected using the highest single-run test-set accuracy, not untouched source test selection.

Short-game regret is conditional on accepted moves and each prompt's different visited states/termination; illegal attempts stop a rollout. Ten starting positions and at most ten model moves do not establish broad chess performance.
No statistically significant mean-regret improvement in the evaluated game rollouts. Do not infer that +7.57 percentage-point Flash Lite puzzle gain generalizes to the stronger Luna or all tasks.
Read source methods, changed paragraphs, principal tables, cross-model/source-prompt selection, game scoring and appendix configurations; not an experiment or significance-test rerun.
